questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some lights are fans.

All fans are switches.

All wires are lights.

**Conclusions:**

I. All wires are fans.

II. Some wires are switches.

III. Some lights are switches.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram of given statements is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e968ba16866c5a07c7f2784f0b299d2b90a99cc1e7549b6186d5a3391893615.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All wires are fans.→ False(As there is no definite relation between them as shown above)

II. Some wires are switches.→ False( There is not any definite relation between wires and switches)

III. Some lights are switches.→ True(As some lights are fans and all fans are switches. So it is possible as shown above in Venn diagram)

Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, **"Option 4" **is the **correct answer.**

If A denotes '+', B denotes '×', C denotes '-', and D denotes '÷', then what will come in place of '?' in the following equation?

(89 C 8) B ? D 81 = 729
questions.solution:
We interchange the given symbols & solve the equation using BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6972ca2bd0f55403c785a28eac679683ab8c50fef081299880b93368de1eaf7.png] 

 
 

 Symbol
 Meaning
 
 

 A
 +
 
 

 B
 ×
 
 

 C
 -
 
 

 D
 ÷
 
 

Given expression: (89 C 8) B ? D 81 = 729

By interchanging the symbols and by using the BODMAS rule we get,

__**(89 - 8)**__ × ? ÷ 81** **= 729

81 × ? ÷ 81 = 729

We take all the sigs at the right hand side, we get:

? = __**729 ÷ 81**__ × 81

? = __**9 **× 81__

**Answer =** **729**

Thus, ? will be replaced by 729 in the following equation.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'PEOPLE' is written as 'VOPOVK' and 'PUBLIC' is written as 'XRLBFK'.How will 'SECTOR' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
According to English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Step 1): First two and last two alphabets are coded as the opposite alphabet.**

**Step 2): Third and fourth alphabets are written as it is.**

**Step 3): The alphabet is then arranged backward to form the code.**

**​**The pattern followed in the given codes is:

'PEOPLE' is written as 'VOPOVK'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdb9d0e1280aec95a170e87ee671710e48bc2ba55581c1edfc3eec626c0bac9.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6c0550fddba50a8ab2200b93749c232631e7f5ee60151d1c34b9e5e9a535c55.png] 

Similarly,

'SECTOR' will be written as **'ILTCVH'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5fe29413770f68006a6d98c57d88e5417ce28519aec8475464062b4baad0ed3.png]
